status.label: Installer scope mismatch
status.detail: The supplied installer log explicitly reports an existing all-users installation while a user installer is being run.

next_action.label: Explain supported upgrade path
next_action.reason: The log already identifies the blocking installation-scope condition rather than an unexplained update failure.

comment.body: The attached log shows that the user installer detected an existing all-users PowerToys installation and intentionally stopped with: “PowerToys is already installed on this system for all users.” Please update through the matching machine-wide deployment channel, or have an administrator remove the existing all-users installation before installing the per-user package. If the matching machine-wide update also fails, please attach that installer log so a separate installer defect can be investigated.

judgment.rationale: The current evidence shows an expected installer guard against mixing machine-wide and per-user installation scopes, not a demonstrated PowerToys update defect.
evidence: The log detects PowerToys version 0.65.0 as installed for all users.
The executable being run is the PowerToys user setup for 0.101.2362.
The installer stops with an explicit recommendation to uninstall the all-users version first.
judgment.recommended_action: Post installation-scope guidance and request a machine-wide installer log only if the supported upgrade path also fails.
